settings.question_3: When should I use the V34 Colour Corrector?
settings.answer_3:
V34 is recommended to be used as a post brushing treatment, however it can be used on its own daily or before an event, to eliminate unwanted yellow undertones on your teeth.


Recommended usage time: 3 times a week - please note there is no harm using the V34 daily.
settings.question_4: How does the V34 whiten my teeth?
settings.answer_4:
✔ V34 Colour Corrector utilises colour-correcting technology. Purple is directly opposite yellow on the colour wheel and is therefore its complementary colour, so a water-soluble purple dye is applied to help neutralise yellow undertones on your teeth.


✔ While oxidising agents like PAP+ aim to increase brightness by reducing yellow saturation, V34 instead balances warm and cool tones (hue) in your smile to reveal a more vibrant appearance.


✔ Contains mineral-based ingredients, which help maintain comfort during use and support a refreshed feel.
settings.answer_5:
Do not swallow the colour corrector, if swallowed in small quantities do not worry.

Do not let the colour corrector get near your eyes, rub water if V34 gets into contact with or near eyes.

Recommended for ages 12 and above. Not recommended for children.

settings.heading: Frequently Asked Questions
settings.question_1: How often should I update my oral care tools?
settings.answer_1: Most people refresh their tools every few months to keep their routine feeling clean and comfortable.
settings.question_2: Can I combine different Smile Therapy products in my routine?
settings.answer_2: Yes. Our products are designed to work well together as part of a simple everyday oral care routine.
settings.question_3: What is a good daily oral hygiene habit?
settings.answer_3: Sticking to a consistent routine helps. Regular brushing and using tools that fit your needs keeps things feeling fresh.
settings.question_4: Are your products suitable for sensitive users?
settings.answer_4: Yes. Many Smile Therapy items include gentler settings or softer materials for a more comfortable experience.
settings.question_5: What can I use for spots that are hard to clean?
settings.answer_5: Precision style tools can make it easier to reach areas that feel difficult to clean with a regular brush alone.
settings.question_6: What if my smile looks dull or not as bright?
settings.answer_6: Simple habits like consistent cleaning and paying attention to stain prone areas can help your smile feel fresher over time.
